convertibility_reason: Uses two custom indicators (2pbIdeal1MA, 2pbIdeal3MA) via iCustom, and relies on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution, position management, and money management logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds for signal timestamp
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime passed to BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation

other_exits: Signal-based close: when 2pbIdeal1MA crosses below 2pbIdeal3MA, long positions are closed (if BuyPosClose=true); when 2pbIdeal1MA crosses above 2pbIdeal3MA, short positions are closed (if SellPosClose=true)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MM parameter: negative values treated as fixed lot size (e.g. -0.1 = 0.1 lots), positive values treated as deposit fraction for deal sizing. Logic is inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses previous bar comparison (Ma1[1] vs Ma2[1]) to detect crossover state, then current bar (Ma1[0] vs Ma2[0]) to confirm direction. Signal is only evaluated on new bar or when Recount is triggered after a CopyBuffer failure. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are computed as last bar date plus one timeframe period, used by the trading library as the signal timestamp. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean gates controlling which trade directions are permitted. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit for cleanup.
python_conversion_notes: Two custom indicators (2pbIdeal1MA, 2pbIdeal3MA) must be reimplemented in Python since they are not built-in MT5 indicators. Their exact algorithm is unknown from this EA alone—their .mq5 source files must be located and ported. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all order execution, position sizing (conditional on MM sign), position closing, and global variable cleanup; this library must also be analyzed and reimplemented. The crossover logic itself is straightforward: compare buffer values at index [1] (previous bar) and [0] (signal bar) from both indicators. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so verify whether the platform uses 5-digit pricing and whether point values need adjustment. Signal bar parameter (default=1) means signals are read from 1 bar back, not the current forming bar.
